summary.text: Rodney Pol, listed by Ballotpedia as Rodney Pol Jr., is a Democratic Indiana state senator who has represented District 4 since November 2021 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was appointed by the local Democratic caucus to replace Karen Tallian.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the state Senate, Pol was the city attorney for the City of Gary and, before that, a deputy public defender for the Indiana State Public Defender's Office.
He received his B.A. and J.D. from Indiana University.
Pol assumed office in the state Senate on November 1, 2021.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Corrections and Criminal Law, Ethics (vice chair), Pensions and Labor, Senate Judiciary, and Rules and Legislative Procedure committees.
